title: chrysanthemum montanum var. corsicum
intro: Chrysanthemum montanum var. corsicum, commonly known as alpine chrysanthemum or Corsican chrysanthemum, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of alpine chrysanthemum include its ability to calm the nervous system and reduce anxiety, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help to relieve muscle and joint pain. The bioactive constituents of alpine chrysanthemum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
